reviewer.role: Independent read-only source and evidence reviewer
reviewer.authority: Proposed review record for root coordinator; no shared canonical status updates

findings: Shared pure readiness reducer binds the accepted planning focus to the exact canonical task source, checks relevant focus/prerequisite source freshness, and keeps unrelated drift advisory before preparation.
Core preflight and new/resumed platform IMPLEMENTING admission refuse unready work while retaining blocked/deferred updates, evidence recording, reconciliation and maintenance paths.

Managed preparation checks readiness before candidate or event effects; malformed or missing profiles remain observable. Prepared orders intentionally retain full inspected-snapshot freshness protection.
Default atlas CLI and live atlas render canonical current work separately from planning focus and historical observations, with mismatches visible.

Final correction is confined to two test expectations: old request remains STALE_BASELINE; refreshed review request now reaches earlier NOT_READY; atlas fixture expects its actual generated M-06 title.

verification.method: Read-only source inspection, independently computed all 13 SHA-256 hashes and candidate digest, reverse-content hash verification of exact final test literal deltas, and inspection of recorded build/TAP outputs.

limitations: This accepts the bounded 13-file source change and reviewed focused evidence, not canonical task completion or global project quality.
Full npm test and browser/live qualification remain separately owned and reported by the root coordinator; this reviewer did not perform them.
This readiness gate does not prove architectural correctness, guarantee bug-free code, restrict arbitrary manual filesystem edits, or control other Codex chats.

Relevant sources govern new admission; already prepared orders bind the full approval snapshot and require refreshed orders after any inspected source drift. No source auto-repinning or canonical checkpoint mutation is introduced.
